name: ZecTrix NOTE4C Devkit
description: Battery-powered 400x300 four-colour BWRY (black/white/red/yellow) e-paper devkit. Community firmware by varanu5 speaks Tesserae's REST device API and Cloud relay, and paints frames the esp32_bin renderer packs to 2-bpp BWRY. Shares the PicPak wire protocol.
notes_md: Community firmware by [varanu5](https://github.com/varanu5/zectrix-note4c-devkit-tesserae-client), confirmed on real hardware over REST and Cloud relay. For the four-colour NOTE4C only, not the grayscale NOTE4. The firmware enforces a 30 second minimum sleep interval.
